mapper.insert: INSERT INTO beacons (class_id, beacon_uuid, major_value, minor_value, rssi_threshold, location_name, active_yn, gps_latitude, gps_longitude) VALUES (#{classId}, #{beaconUuid}, #{majorValue}, #{minorValue}, #{rssiThreshold}, #{locationName}, #{activeYn}, #{gpsLatitude}, #{gpsLongitude})
